FilesError_busy.One: Another transfer is in progress. Retry when it finishes.

FilesError_io.One: Could not complete the file operation. Check the connection, free space, and permissions.

DeviceConnectionTerminal_disabled.One: Terminal disabled. Check the terminal permission on the device.

DeviceConnectionTerminal_unsupported.One: Terminal unsupported. Check the device OS and official client version.

DeviceConnectionWebDisabled.One: An administrator must enable Web Client for desktop connections in the browser.

DeviceConnectionReportNeeded.One: Run the official install command again to enable automatic device state reports.

OfficialInstallRegistrationHint.One: Once installation finishes, the device is assigned to your account. Conflicting ownership stops registration.

OfficialInstallMyDevices.One: View My Devices and connect to the web terminal

WebTerminalExplanation.One: Checks the official RustDesk terminal permission before opening a shell. Use your saved installation password or enter the device password. Closing this dialog ends the connection.

WebTerminalPasswordSaveFailed.One: Connected, but the password could not be saved. Enter it again next time.

TerminalState_signature_failed.One: Server or device identity verification failed

TerminalState_access_denied.One: Check web login and device permissions

TerminalHelp_unknown.One: Terminal permission is unknown until device authentication. Check results expire after one minute.

TerminalHelp_checking.One: Checking server and device signatures, terminal support and permission.

TerminalHelp_allowed.One: Device authentication and terminal permission confirmed. Connecting opens a remote shell.

TerminalHelp_ready.One: The remote shell is open. Keyboard input and size changes are forwarded to the device.

TerminalHelp_disabled.One: The client or server policy denied terminal access. Check enable-terminal and retry.

TerminalHelp_unsupported.One: The device did not advertise terminal support. Check the latest official client and supported OS.

TerminalHelp_auth_required.One: Authentication did not complete. Check the current device password, approval mode and additional authentication.

TerminalHelp_unavailable.One: Could not verify the connection. Check the running client, server and relay. This does not mean terminal access is disabled.

TerminalHelp_configuration.One: An administrator must check ID server, relay, public key and HTTPS API settings.

TerminalHelp_pty_failed.One: Access was allowed but the shell failed to open. Check the shell account, permissions and device terminal service.

TerminalHelp_busy.One: The concurrent connection or request limit was reached. Close unused terminal sessions and try again shortly.

TerminalHelp_saved_password_unavailable.One: The saved installation password could not be read. Turn off the saved password option and enter the device's current unattended access password to reconnect.

TerminalHelp_key_mismatch.One: The ID server rejected the public key. An administrator must verify the default server profile's public key.

TerminalHelp_offline.One: The ID server reported the device offline. Check the device's running RustDesk process and ID server connection.

TerminalHelp_peer_not_found.One: This device ID is not registered on the ID server. Check the device ID and server.

TerminalHelp_server_rejected.One: The ID server or relay rejected the request. An administrator must check server policies, limits and logs.

TerminalHelp_signature_failed.One: Server or device signature verification failed, so the connection was stopped. An administrator must check the public key and device registration.

TerminalHelp_id_server_unreachable.One: The API could not connect to the ID server. An administrator must check its address, DNS, port and network access from the API.

TerminalHelp_relay_unreachable.One: The API could not connect to the relay. An administrator must check its address, port and running state.

TerminalHelp_connection_timeout.One: The stage below did not respond before the timeout. Check its server or device and network before retrying.

TerminalHelp_connection_closed.One: The remote side closed the connection or the session was interrupted. Check the server or device at the stage below and retry.

TerminalHelp_protocol_error.One: The response could not be processed. An administrator must check server and client versions and logs for the stage below.

TerminalHelp_browser_transport.One: The browser could not open the API WebSocket. Refresh and retry. If it persists, an administrator must check HTTPS, proxy settings and login state.

TerminalHelp_request_failed.One: The API could not issue a connection request. Check the error notice, login, saved password and request limits before retrying.

TerminalHelp_access_denied.One: Web login or device access was denied. Sign in again and check device ownership.

TerminalHelp_browser_terminal_error.One: The terminal display could not be prepared after device connection. Refresh and check browser file blocking or network errors.

OfficialInstallHint.One: Click the copy icon for the target OS and CPU. Run the copied command to install the latest official stable client, configure your server, register the device and enable connection state reports.

OfficialInstallArchitectureHint.One: x64 is for Intel and AMD; ARM64 is for ARM CPUs. The script detects the target device's actual CPU and selects the matching official package.

OfficialInstallCopying.One: Preparing and copying the {target} installation command…

OfficialInstallWindowsHint.One: Run in administrator PowerShell. The script detects the 64-bit OS and CPU and stops if an official native package is unavailable.

OfficialInstallMacHint.One: Detects Intel and Apple Silicon. The selected account needs a macOS login session and system approval for screen recording and accessibility.

OfficialInstallLinuxHint.One: Supports x64/ARM64 systemd Ubuntu/Debian and Rocky/Alma with Python 3. Devices without a GUI use terminal access.

OfficialInstallPasswordHelp.One: Used for new devices and saved when you click a copy icon. Existing device passwords are preserved by default.

OfficialInstallShellHint.One: Defaults to the OS user running the script, or the original sudo user. Use an existing regular account. Windows follows the client's OS login session.

OfficialInstallReplacePassword.One: Enable unattended access with this password on an existing device

OfficialInstallReplaceServer.One: Allow switching a device connected to another server

OfficialInstallSwitch.One: Allow replacing an internal client with the official version

OfficialInstallPreserve.One: Preserves IDs and existing settings. Skips reinstalling the same version and does not automatically convert existing desktop installations to terminal mode.

OfficialInstallServerMissing.One: An administrator must configure an HTTPS API address, ID server and public key.

OfficialInstallInvalid.One: Use at least 8 password characters. Linux and macOS accounts must use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, dots or hyphens and cannot be root. Windows accounts allow up to 96 bytes. Copy is available for operating systems that accept the entered account.

OfficialInstallExpired.One: Command expired. Click its copy icon again.

OfficialInstallCommandHint.One: Run on the selected target OS. Windows requires administrator PowerShell; Linux and macOS use a terminal with sudo.

OfficialInstallTokenHint.One: Valid once for 15 minutes. Copying again to issue a new command revokes the previous one. Keep the command private.

OfficialInstallGenerateError.One: A secure HTTPS environment is required to generate passwords.

OfficialInstallPrepareError.One: Could not create a command. Check server settings and inputs, then retry.

OfficialInstallCopyFallback.One: Could not copy to the clipboard. Click the same copy icon again or select the command above and copy it manually.
